events.title: Pennsylvania State Capitol tour
events.blurb: Free 30–45 minute guided tours of the 1906 Capitol run Friday through Sunday at 9 and 11 a.m. and 1 and 3 p.m. Each tour takes up to 40 people, so booking ahead is recommended.
events.blurbEs: Visitas guiadas gratis de 30 a 45 minutos al Capitolio de 1906, de viernes a domingo a las 9 y 11 a.m. y a la 1 y 3 p.m. Cada visita admite hasta 40 personas, así que se recomienda reservar.
events.getThere: On weekends and holidays the only public entrance is off Third and State Streets.

events.title: Christmas at Fort Hunter: Toy Trains & Festival of Trees
events.blurb: Opening weekend of Christmas at Fort Hunter: a free HO-gauge toy train layout from the Keystone Model Railroad Historical Society and six themed trees trimmed by local garden clubs, both in the Centennial Barn.
events.blurbEs: Fin de semana de apertura de Christmas at Fort Hunter: una maqueta gratis de trenes de juguete escala HO de la Keystone Model Railroad Historical Society y seis árboles temáticos decorados por clubes de jardinería locales, en el Centennial Barn.

events.title: Hersheypark Christmas Candylane: Fire & Ice opening night
events.blurb: The holiday park's new Fire & Ice Experience starts Friday, with shows every 15 minutes from 5:15 p.m. and fireworks at 8 p.m. Admission includes family rides, select coasters, the TREEville trail, lights, Santa and ZooAmerica.
events.blurbEs: El nuevo Fire & Ice Experience del parque navideño empieza el viernes, con espectáculos cada 15 minutos desde las 5:15 p.m. y fuegos artificiales a las 8 p.m. La entrada incluye juegos familiares, algunas montañas rusas, el sendero TREEville, las luces, Santa y ZooAmerica.

events.title: Gimme Gimme Disco
events.blurb: The touring ABBA-themed disco dance party plays the Lower Level on Black Friday night.
events.blurbEs: La fiesta de baile disco con temática de ABBA llega al Lower Level la noche del Black Friday.

events.title: SoMa Christmas Market + Block Party
events.addr: S 3rd St between Market St & Chestnut St, Harrisburg, PA 17101
events.blurb: A free outdoor holiday market downtown with shopping, live music, Santa's Workshop and food trucks. Street parking is free all day Sunday.
events.blurbEs: Un mercado navideño gratis al aire libre en el centro, con compras, música en vivo, el taller de Santa y food trucks. El estacionamiento en la calle es gratis todo el domingo.
